GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Plumbing, drainage & gas

We investigate plumbing faults and define the affected service before arranging repairs. We cover agreed work to water supply, hot water, sanitary plumbing, drainage and gas systems, with clear separation between the immediate fault and any wider replacement work. We coordinate shutdowns with the people using the building.

What we can look after

  • Leaking fittings, water supply and hot water issues.
  • Blocked or damaged drainage and recurring overflow investigation.
  • Gas service and equipment work defined for the specific premises.

Planning the work

  1. We identify the affected service, symptoms and accessible pipework.
  2. We confirm shutdowns, access, investigation and repair allowances.
  3. We check operation after the work and document the completed scope.

Questions about this service

What information helps you quote a drainage problem?+

We use the property address, the affected fixtures or area, when the problem occurs and any available photos to plan the investigation. If the cause is concealed, we explain the investigation scope before quoting the final repair.
